text:
Kim (People Ops): Quick heads-up: Jordan's onboarding hit a snag. Their passport and SSN file are under their previous last name (Garcia) but their offer and new email use their married name (Lopez). Jordan mentioned they filed the name-change court order last week and have a digital copy incoming.

Elena (HR): Thanks. For name-change cases we need either: (A) certified court order + updated SSN record, or (B) a short notarized name-change affidavit + original ID shown on a recorded video for provisional I-9. Which can Jordan do fastest?

Jordan (New Hire): Morning! I can upload the scanned court order PDF tonight (it's signed but waiting for the certified copy in the mail). I can also do a 5-min recorded video with the old passport and the signed order visible. Prefer to keep my start date Monday if possible.

Kim (People Ops): Two constraints: 1) IT won't ship the laptop or activate badge until I-9 Section 2 satisfied, 2) Payroll needs the W-4 name to match SSN registry or payroll validations fail. We can provision cloud access and join Day-1 orientation remotely if HR logs an exception.

Omar (IT): Confirmed. We can create a temporary dev-only account and email alias under the employee name but block payroll groups and VPN. Physical device held. If HR marks 'provisional-verified' we can enable repo access and Slack.

Marta (Payroll): Important: if we create a payroll record with a name that doesn't match SSA, payroll will reject tax setup. Options: delay W-2 enrollment until SSA update or set up payroll under the legal name with alias for display. Legal prefers payroll under legal name (SSN match). If you want benefits immediately, that's a separate enrollment step but benefits vendor also validates SSA data.

Onboard-Bot: New case created BG-13044. Status: name-change-docs-pending.

Elena (HR): Proposed flow: Jordan records a 3-5min video tonight reading this attestation and showing the passport + signed court order scanned copy; People Ops will log an exception and mark start as "remote-day1-provisional". Once certified court order arrives (scanned), HR updates SSA/IRS records and payroll toggles benefits and full access.

Elena (HR): Attestation script (copy/paste):

"I, Jordan Lopez (formerly Jordan Garcia), attest that the passport and the name-change court order shown in this recording are authentic and belong to me. I consent to Redwood Inference recording and retaining this verification for onboarding and I-9 purposes."

Jordan (New Hire): I'll record at 7pm PT and upload to the secure intake link. Also note: I was an active contractor (1099) with vendor 'FlexDev' last quarter. Will that cause any conflicts when converting to W-2?

Kim (People Ops): Good catch. We need to deprovision the contractor identity and ensure there's no duplicate payment. Please confirm your contractor invoice email so Finance can cross-check and close prior vendor payments.

Marta (Payroll): Finance flag: contractors paid via AP -> separate ledger. We need a clearance note from Finance that contractor payments are complete before creating a W-2 record to avoid duplicate compensation. I'll loop in Finance after Jordan uploads docs.

Omar (IT): On the access side, we'll transfer GitHub org membership from the contractor team to employee team. Jordan, expect a brief permissions gap during the swap. We'll keep your repo forks but rotate keys if you had personal deploy tokens.

Jordan (New Hire): Uploaded the recording and the unsigned scanned order (PDF link: https://files.redwood.com/upload/JL-change - placeholder). I also DM'd Finance the contractor invoice emails. Thanks.

Elena (HR): Received the recording. Logging exception: tag `name-change-provisional`, start-date: confirmed remote-day1, benefits: deferred until legal docs certified, payroll: pending SSA match. Updating BG-13044.

Onboard-Bot: BG-13044 status -> provisional-verified (video received).

Marta (Payroll): Thanks. I'll hold W-4 processing and mark payroll record pending SSA-verify. Please note benefits enrollment will be queued and retro-processed if verification completes within 30 days. Also Finance: @Finance please confirm contractor ledger clearance for Jordan to avoid duplicate payments.

Kim (People Ops): IT: Omar, proceed with cloud account + Slack + calendar invite for Day-1 orientation. Do not ship laptop or activate badge until HR confirms certified court order scanned.

Omar (IT): Copy that. Provisioning cloud accounts now. Will DM Jordan MFA steps and note laptop hold.

Marta (Payroll): FYI payroll validator also wants the SSN without dashes. Jordan, when you submit W-4 make sure SSN format is `#########`.

Jordan (New Hire): Got it 44d resubmitted W-4 without dashes. I informed Finance about contractor invoices. Will forward certified court order when it arrives and confirm with HR.

Elena (HR): Great work everyone. Closing loop: 1) provisional access granted for Day-1 orientation, 2) HR will mark BG case and Onboard Exceptions sheet `name-change-provisional`, 3) Payroll holds benefits/w-2 until SSA match, 4) IT holds device until HR says green. I'll post updates when certified order scanned. :white_check_mark:
